title: Liquidity shock
description: How much the book has thinned or widened in the last minute. Depth and spread right now are compared with their average over the last sixty seconds.

state.label: Liquidity state
state.description: Normal, thinning or shocked, read from depth and spread against the last minute. Shocked means the book cannot absorb a normal order without moving.

depth_ratio_60s.label: Depth vs 60s
depth_ratio_60s.description: Size resting near the touch now, as a change against its one-minute average. Negative means the book has thinned.

spread_ratio_60s.label: Spread vs 60s
spread_ratio_60s.description: The bid-ask spread now, as a change against its one-minute average. Positive means trading has got more expensive.
